contentHtml:
DLF Camellias interior design in Sector 42 is a full bare-shell fit-out of a 7,350 to 16,290 sq ft apartment: flooring, bathrooms, kitchens, joinery, lighting and automation. Brokers estimate fit-out cost at ₹8,000 to ₹15,000 per sq ft, which means several crores per home. Procurement of stone and imported fittings usually sets the timeline.

DLF The Camellias sits at the top of Gurgaon's residential market. Apartments start above 7,000 sq ft, resale prices are quoted in the tens of crores, and most homes are handed over as bare shells. That last point decides everything about the interior. You are not decorating an apartment. You are building one inside a finished tower.

Key Takeaways

  • Camellias has 429 apartments in 9 towers, from about 7,350 to 16,290 sq ft.
  • Most units are bare shell, so the scope includes wet areas, flooring and services, not just furniture.
  • Budget in crores. Published broker estimates run ₹8,000 to ₹15,000 per sq ft.
  • The decisions that matter most are made before site work starts: zoning, services, stone and team structure.

For how the wider corridor differs from the rest of the city, see what makes Golf Course Road interiors different. This guide stays inside one address.

A Camellias Interior Is a Fit-Out, Not a Makeover

In most Gurgaon societies the builder hands over finished floors, bathrooms and a basic kitchen. The interior firm adds woodwork, lighting and furniture. At Camellias, units are delivered as bare shells so each owner can build to a personal specification. A ₹100 crore sale registered in August 2025 was reported as a bare-shell apartment.

That widens the scope to:

  • Flooring across the full floor plate, in stone or timber.
  • Every bathroom, including waterproofing, plumbing fixtures and cladding.
  • Kitchens, often a show kitchen and a separate working kitchen.
  • Ceilings, doors and internal finishes, depending on what your unit was handed over with.
  • Electrical, lighting control, automation and AV wiring.
  • Joinery, wall panelling, loose furniture, art and soft furnishing.

Before any design work, get the handover specification for your unit from the seller or DLF's estate team. It tells you what is already installed and what is not.

What the Building Gives You to Design With

Camellias' launch specifications describe features that shape every layout. Confirm each one for your own tower and floor.

FeatureLaunch specificationWhat it means for the interior
One apartment per coreA single apartment per lift core with a private lift lobbyThe lobby is the first room of the home. Design it with the same care as the living room.
Ceiling heightFloor-to-floor about 12 ft 3 in; clear height of 11 ft or moreTall joinery, layered lighting and larger artwork. Standard-height wardrobes look undersized.
GlazingAbout 9 ft 6 in highMotorised curtains and solar control are planned with the ceiling.
DecksFront decks 10 to 12 ft deep; rear deck up to 8 ftTreat them as outdoor rooms, with weather-rated materials.
Air conditioningVRF system with individual controlCeilings must work around indoor units, ducts and access panels.
Fresh airTreated fresh air unitsKeep supply and return paths clear. Do not box them in.

The view does the rest. The towers face the golf course, so living, dining and the primary suite are oriented to it first, and the plan follows.

What a DLF Camellias Fit-Out Costs

There is no public rate card. Brokers who handle Camellias resales estimate ₹8,000 to ₹15,000 per sq ft to fit out a bare shell. Applied to DLF's published unit sizes:

UnitSizeAt ₹8,000 per sq ftAt ₹15,000 per sq ft
Smallest apartment7,350 sq ft₹5.9 crore₹11.0 crore
Mid-size apartment (reported)9,500 sq ft₹7.6 crore₹14.3 crore
Penthouse13,000 sq ft₹10.4 crore₹19.5 crore
Largest penthouse16,290 sq ft₹13.0 crore₹24.4 crore

Two cautions. First, these figures multiply the estimate by super area, and the area you actually fit out is smaller. In the ₹190 crore deal, the reported rates on super and carpet area imply carpet was roughly two-thirds of super area. Second, this is a broker estimate, not an Omega quotation. A real number needs drawings and a specification.

What moves a project within the range:

  • Stone: the marble chosen, book-matching and wastage.
  • Bathrooms: how many, and the fixture specification.
  • Kitchens: imported systems versus custom-built.
  • Joinery: veneer and solid wood, bespoke versus modular.
  • Lighting and automation: the level of control and integration.
  • Loose furniture and art, which are often budgeted separately.

When quotes arrive, check that they describe the same scope. Our guide on how to compare interior design quotations covers the method.

How a Camellias Project Runs

StageWhat happensWhat sets the pace
1. Brief and surveyMeasured survey of the shell, services audit, lifestyle briefAvailability of handover drawings
2. Concept and layoutsZoning, furniture layouts, material direction, 3D viewsNumber of decision-makers
3. Services and detail designElectrical, lighting, automation and joinery drawings coordinatedConsultant coordination
4. ApprovalsFit-out drawings shared with estate management as requiredSociety process
5. ProcurementStone selection, imported fittings and long-lead items orderedProduction and shipping lead times, often several months
6. Site executionWaterproofing, services, ceilings, flooring, joinery, finishesSequencing and work-hour rules
7. Snagging and handoverRoom-by-room checks, services testing, walkthroughQuality of the checks done earlier

Our standard full-home turnkey projects run 8 to 16 weeks. A bare-shell fit-out at this size takes considerably longer, and procurement, not labour, usually sets the date. Order long-lead items as soon as the design is frozen.

Camellias is an occupied, managed building. Expect rules on working hours, material movement, service lift use and contractor entry. Ask the estate team for the current fit-out guidelines before fixing a schedule.

Five Design Decisions That Matter Most

1. Zone the floor plate before choosing a style

At 7,350 sq ft and above on one level, the plan needs separate entertaining, family, private and service zones, each with its own circulation. Staff and service movement should not cross the formal rooms.

2. Design the lighting with the ceiling

With 11 ft of clear height, a single grid of downlights leaves rooms flat. Plan ambient, accent and decorative layers together with the air-conditioning layout, on one drawing.

3. Select stone in person, and early

Flooring is the largest visible surface and the longest lead item. Choose slabs at the yard, mark them, and order with an allowance for matching and breakage.

4. Freeze services before joinery

Automation, AV and security need conduits and control points in the right places. Retrofitting them into finished panelling is disruptive and costly. See our smart home interior design guide.

5. Decide what is bespoke

At this scale, wardrobes, panelling and feature furniture are usually made to the room's proportions. Modular systems still suit utility areas and staff rooms. Our comparison of Italian and contemporary luxury styles helps set the direction.

Buying a Resale Apartment: Refit or Rebuild?

Camellias is now a resale market, so some apartments come with a previous owner's interior. Three checks decide whether to keep it, refit it or strip it out:

  • Wet areas: the age and condition of bathrooms and waterproofing.
  • Services: electrical capacity, air-conditioning condition and whether the automation is current.
  • Layout: whether the zoning suits how your family lives.

Bathrooms and services are expensive to change later, so assess those first. Finishes and furniture are the easy part. For homes meant for leasing, where reported rents run from about ₹4.5 lakh to ₹10 lakh a month and higher, a durable, neutral specification makes more sense than a personal one.

Choosing the Team for a Camellias Fit-Out

Ask every firm you shortlist the same six questions:

  1. Who leads design, and who is accountable for execution?
  2. Have they delivered bare-shell scope, including wet areas and services?
  3. Is the BOQ itemised, with brands and stone allowances?
  4. Is there a procurement plan with lead times?
  5. What is the quality-check and snagging process?
  6. What warranty is given in writing, item by item?

The Omega Group is a Gurgaon turnkey studio. Design, procurement and site execution sit with one team, with 70+ quality checks on a typical project, and Golf Course Road is part of our regular service area. On a Camellias brief we can lead the full fit-out or execute alongside an architect or designer you have already appointed.

faqs.question: Are DLF Camellias apartments sold furnished?
faqs.answer: No. Most Camellias apartments were delivered as bare shells so owners could build their own interiors. Some resale units come with a previous owner's fit-out, so check the handover condition of the specific apartment before you budget.

faqs.question: How much does interior design cost in DLF Camellias?
faqs.answer: Brokers estimate ₹8,000 to ₹15,000 per sq ft for a bare-shell fit-out. On the smallest 7,350 sq ft apartment that is roughly ₹5.9 crore to ₹11 crore on super area. Actual cost depends on stone, bathrooms, kitchens, joinery and automation.

faqs.question: How big are the apartments in DLF Camellias?
faqs.answer: DLF states the 429 apartments range from about 7,350 to 16,290 sq ft across 9 towers. There are 12 penthouses of about 13,000 sq ft and 2 of about 16,290 sq ft.

faqs.question: How long does a Camellias interior project take?
faqs.answer: Longer than a standard apartment, which typically takes 8 to 16 weeks. A bare-shell fit-out adds flooring, bathrooms and services, and imported stone and fittings often carry lead times of several months. Procurement usually decides the handover date.

faqs.question: Can I renovate a resale Camellias apartment that is already fitted out?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start by assessing bathrooms, waterproofing and services, since those cost the most to change. Many buyers keep sound services and redo finishes, joinery and furniture. Confirm the society's current fit-out rules before planning the work.

faqs.question: Who designed DLF Camellias?
faqs.answer: Hafeez Contractor is the principal architect. The 160,000 sq ft Camellias Club was designed by Rockwell Group of New York. The development holds LEED Platinum certification.

faqs.question: Do I need an architect, or can a turnkey firm handle it?
faqs.answer: Either works if accountability is clear. Some owners appoint an architect or designer and a separate execution team. Others use one turnkey firm for both. What matters is a single party answerable for coordination, quality and schedule.
